en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a dramatic sunset or dusk scene in Trento, with the silhouetted Monument to Dante in the foreground on a high pedestal, the figure pointing outward. In the background, on a hill, a circular colonnaded structure identified as the Monument to Cesare Battisti is visible. Tall trees and mountainous terrain frame the monuments, and handwritten-style text runs along the bottom border.
